boss-careless.desc: a bath house regular at the tea counter

boss-careful.desc: a bath house regular at the tea counter

informant.desc: the bath house front desk attendant

red-herring-bath-regular.desc: a bath regular who pays in cash

s5-lurker.desc: a young man at the platform bench

extra:stranger.desc: a man at the lift doors

free-tea-rolled-towel.1.1.line: {boss-careless} takes the end stool at the bath house tea counter in the early morning.

free-tea-rolled-towel.1.2.line: {go-between-clerk} pours a cup of tea and slides it across to {boss-careless}.

free-tea-rolled-towel.1.3.line: {boss-careless} walks out with the cup, and no payment crosses the counter.

free-tea-rolled-towel.1.4.line: {go-between-clerk} waves off {extra:patron}, who is pointing at the waiting queue.

free-tea-rolled-towel.2.1.line: {inside-officer} walks into the pools in the afternoon, no badge showing.

free-tea-rolled-towel.2.2.line: {boss-careless} passes {inside-officer} a rolled towel at the pool edge.

free-tea-rolled-towel.2.3.line: {inside-officer} carries the rolled towel out past the front desk.

free-tea-rolled-towel.2.4.line: {informant} stands at the front desk, eyes on the floor, as {boss-careless} walks by.

tab-slips-skipped-door-exact-cha.1.1.line: {go-between-clerk} and {boss-careless} chat about the weather across the tea counter.

tab-slips-skipped-door-exact-cha.1.2.line: {go-between-clerk} marks a paper tab and tucks it under the till.

tab-slips-skipped-door-exact-cha.2.1.line: {go-between-clerk} taps a stack of paper credit slips against the cup in front of {boss-careless}.

tab-slips-skipped-door-exact-cha.2.2.line: {inside-officer} and {framed-officer} walk their patrol up to the bath house door.

tab-slips-skipped-door-exact-cha.2.3.line: {framed-officer} scans the door and writes the time in a paper notebook.

tab-slips-skipped-door-exact-cha.2.4.line: {inside-officer} keeps walking without a scan and waves {framed-officer} along.

tab-slips-skipped-door-exact-cha.3.1.line: {go-between-clerk} counts coins into the open palm of {boss-careless}, the exact amount, nothing over.

tab-slips-skipped-door-exact-cha.3.2.line: {red-herring-bath-regular} passes {go-between-clerk} a fold of notes in an odd amount.

tab-slips-skipped-door-exact-cha.3.3.line: {red-herring-bath-regular} and {go-between-clerk} argue over a tab, voices rising over the kettle.

roll-past-the-bench-clerk-gone.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} sits on the bench by the front desk at midday.

roll-past-the-bench-clerk-gone.1.2.line: {veteran-officer} says to {extra:patron}: "Fifteen days left on my badge."

roll-past-the-bench-clerk-gone.1.3.line: {informant} sits on the same bench with a rice box and says nothing.

roll-past-the-bench-clerk-gone.1.4.line: {inside-officer} walks past the bench with a rolled towel under {inside-officer.his} arm.

roll-past-the-bench-clerk-gone.1.5.line: {informant} gets up from the bench and goes back to the front desk.

roll-past-the-bench-clerk-gone.2.1.line: {go-between-clerk} stands at the tea counter in the early morning, a coat over the stool.

roll-past-the-bench-clerk-gone.2.2.line: {go-between-clerk} walks out the service door with the coat over {go-between-clerk.his} arm.

roll-past-the-bench-clerk-gone.2.3.line: {extra:patron} reads a handwritten sign taped to the tea counter: "Back soon."

lift-to-nine.1.1.line: {boss-careless} walks into the Cloud Pagoda lobby late at night, a folded towel on {boss-careless.his} arm.

lift-to-nine.1.2.line: {boss-careless} passes the Cloud Pagoda front desk without stopping.

lift-to-nine.1.3.line: {boss-careless} reaches for the lift panel and presses nine.

lift-to-nine.1.4.line: The lift doors close on {boss-careless}, and the floor counter climbs to nine.

lift-to-nine.1.5.line: Comm, one side: "Not now, Mama. I said ten."

lift-to-nine.1.6.line: {family-caller-officer} stands with {family-caller-officer.his} back to the lifts, comm at {family-caller-officer.his} ear.

wrong-door-at-03-00.1.1.line: {red-herring-night-courier} knocks at tenement door 4C before dawn and waits, a bag in hand.

wrong-door-at-03-00.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} stands on the stair landing, writing in a notebook.

wrong-door-at-03-00.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} points at the bag {red-herring-night-courier} is carrying.

wrong-door-at-03-00.1.4.line: {red-herring-night-courier} runs down the stairs, the bag clutched to {red-herring-night-courier.his} chest.

left-turn-loose-page.1.1.line: {inside-officer} and {framed-officer} walk their patrol into the bath house lobby.

left-turn-loose-page.1.2.line: {framed-officer} says to {inside-officer}: "Left? The route sheet says right."

left-turn-loose-page.1.3.line: {framed-officer} stops to read the pool rules board, back to the tea counter.

left-turn-loose-page.1.4.line: {inside-officer} lifts a folded page out of the till drawer.

left-turn-loose-page.1.5.line: {inside-officer} tucks the folded page out of sight and walks on.

left-turn-loose-page.2.1.line: {burnout-officer} sits on a pool bench in the afternoon and stays there forty minutes.

left-turn-loose-page.2.2.line: {burnout-officer} eats from a rice box on the pool bench.

left-turn-loose-page.2.3.line: {burnout-officer} shrugs when {extra:patron} asks about the door scan.

route-slip-names-the-tea-counter.1.1.line: {rookie-officer} reads the paper route slip taken from the arrested lift hall mugger.

route-slip-names-the-tea-counter.1.2.line: {night-stakeout-officer} points at one line on the slip: "tea counter, locker 14, Friday."

route-slip-names-the-tea-counter.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} and {night-stakeout-officer} talk over the slip, heads close together.

route-slip-names-the-tea-counter.1.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} seals the slip in an evidence bag.

front-desk-empty.1.1.line: {extra:patron} waits at the bath house front desk at opening, the chair pushed in and empty.

front-desk-empty.1.2.line: A shift sheet on the front desk has the attendant's name struck through in pen.

front-desk-empty.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} waits at the empty front desk in the late afternoon, hands folded.

front-desk-empty.1.4.line: {veteran-officer} asks {extra:patron} where the front desk attendant has gone.

front-desk-empty.1.5.line: {extra:patron} shrugs at {veteran-officer} and heads for the pools.

poster-covered.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} stands at the station front screens at the start of the morning shift.

poster-covered.1.2.line: A wanted poster of the tea counter clerk has paint sprayed across the face.

poster-covered.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} points {rookie-officer} at the paint across the poster.

poster-covered.1.4.line: {desk-sergeant} and {rookie-officer} talk in front of the painted poster.

courier-at-the-suite-door.1.1.line: {go-between-courier} knocks at Cloud Pagoda suite 9F late at night, a paper bag in hand.

courier-at-the-suite-door.1.2.line: Comm, one side: "You sound rough tonight. Yes, the bag is here."

courier-at-the-suite-door.1.3.line: {go-between-courier} passes the bag through a hand-wide gap in the suite door.

courier-at-the-suite-door.1.4.line: {go-between-courier} walks back to the lift with empty hands.

lurker-caught.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stands at the far platform bench, a paper cup on the ledge.

lurker-caught.1.2.line: {night-stakeout-officer} takes {s5-lurker} firmly by the arm beside the bench.

lurker-caught.1.3.line: {night-stakeout-officer} holds up a photo log: {s5-lurker} seated across from the tea counter on two mornings.

lurker-caught.1.4.line: {red-herring-bath-regular} passes {extra:cousin} a thin bag at the far end of the platform.

partner-opens-the-door.1.1.line: {red-herring-night-courier} knocks at door 4C before dawn, holding flowers and a loaf of bread.

partner-opens-the-door.1.2.line: {extra:partner} opens door 4C and hugs {red-herring-night-courier} on the threshold.

partner-opens-the-door.1.3.line: {extra:partner} waves at a landlord bot humming down the corridor.

locker-14.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} waits by the bath house locker row in the early morning, still as a post.

locker-14.1.2.line: {go-between-courier} walks into the locker room with a paper bag.

locker-14.1.3.line: {go-between-courier} puts the paper bag in locker 14 and shuts the door.

locker-14.1.4.line: {night-stakeout-officer} opens locker 14 with a master key.

locker-14.1.5.line: {rookie-officer} reads the paper tabs and credit slips, cup counts beside the tea counter regular's name.

locker-14.1.6.line: {night-stakeout-officer} and {rookie-officer} arrest {go-between-courier} at the locker row.

locker-14.1.7.line: Posted to the mesh: a photo of {red-herring-bath-regular} with someone at a noodle stall, "Me and my cousin."

locker-14.1.8.line: {red-herring-bath-regular} tells {rookie-officer} the cousin lent {red-herring-bath-regular.him} money to cover a debt.

page-marked-b-bag-gone.1.1.line: {inside-officer} carries an evidence box down the station corridor in the early morning.

page-marked-b-bag-gone.1.2.line: {desk-sergeant} reads a ledger page logged as evidence, with the initials of {framed-officer} penciled in the margin.

page-marked-b-bag-gone.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} finds the tea counter bag tag on the evidence shelf, tied to an empty bag.

page-marked-b-bag-gone.1.4.line: {desk-sergeant} posts a notice to the station screens: "{framed-officer} suspended pending review."

page-marked-b-bag-gone.1.5.line: {framed-officer} argues with {desk-sergeant} over the log entry, tapping the page.

suite-nine-opened.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} and {rookie-officer} knock at suite 9F in the early morning and wait.

suite-nine-opened.1.2.line: {rookie-officer} opens the suite door with a hotel key card.

suite-nine-opened.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} lifts a stack of folded towels off the bed.

suite-nine-opened.1.4.line: Under the towels lie credit slips stamped with the tea counter's mark.

suite-nine-opened.1.5.line: {rookie-officer} seals the credit slips in an evidence bag.

notebook-against-the-logs.1.2.line: {veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} read nine dates marked in the notebook beside skipped door scans.

notebook-against-the-logs.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} reads the comm log for the call to the courier: "Caller comm registered to {inside-officer}, 23:12."

notebook-against-the-logs.1.4.line: {veteran-officer} reads a food counter receipt from the same night: "{framed-officer}, one bowl, 23:09."

notebook-against-the-logs.1.5.line: {desk-sergeant} signs a locker search sheet and slides it across to {veteran-officer}.

notebook-against-the-logs.1.6.line: {veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} open the station locker of {inside-officer}.

notebook-against-the-logs.1.7.line: {rookie-officer} unrolls a towel from the locker and lifts out credit slips.

poster-restored.1.1.line: {desk-sergeant} posts a correction under the suspension notice on the station screens.

poster-restored.1.2.line: {desk-sergeant} stands at the front screens and reads the correction twice.

poster-restored.1.3.line: The tea counter clerk's poster is clean again: "Wanted for questioning."

poster-restored.1.4.line: {extra:passerby} stops in front of the screens and points at the clean poster.

stay-out-of-the-pools.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} watches the pools door in the early morning, a paper cup on the ledge.

stay-out-of-the-pools.1.2.line: {extra:tea-hand} stands at the tea counter beside an empty end stool.

stay-out-of-the-pools.1.3.line: {inside-officer} walks in through the bath house front doors, no badge showing.

stay-out-of-the-pools.1.4.line: Comm, one side, at the front desk: "Not today. Stay out of the pools."

stay-out-of-the-pools.1.5.line: {inside-officer} leaves by the side door without a look at the pools.

found-in-the-lift-hall.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} sits in the lift hall in the afternoon, watching the lift doors.

found-in-the-lift-hall.1.2.line: {informant} steps out of a lift with a rolled bag under one arm.

found-in-the-lift-hall.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} walks {informant} over to the bench outside the food counter.

found-in-the-lift-hall.1.4.line: {informant} tells {veteran-officer}: "Towels go up to nine on Fridays. The regular comes back for tea every morning."

found-in-the-lift-hall.1.5.line: {veteran-officer} and {informant} sit on the bench and eat without talking.

last-cup.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stands at the pools door, a paper cup on the ledge.
last-cup.1.1.note: Seven people in this moment: the stakeout officer, the regular, a stand-in tea server, both pair 2 officers, and both pair 1 officers.

last-cup.1.2.line: {boss-careless} takes the end stool at the tea counter, as on every other morning.

last-cup.1.3.line: {extra:tea-hand} pours tea and slides the cup across to {boss-careless}.

last-cup.1.4.line: {framed-officer} stands at the front desk in uniform, notebook in hand.

last-cup.1.5.line: {inside-officer} walks in through the front doors, no badge showing.

last-cup.1.6.line: {veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} step up to the stool and arrest {boss-careless}.

last-cup.1.8.line: {veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} lead {boss-careless} and {inside-officer} out through the lobby.

care-station-2-log-matches.1.1.line: {rookie-officer} reads a station 2 call log showing the same comm hour as the call to the courier.

care-station-2-log-matches.1.2.line: {desk-sergeant} points at two matching lines, one from each station's log.

care-station-2-log-matches.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} and {rookie-officer} talk over the two logs side by side.

care-swap-refused.1.1.line: {inside-officer} asks {desk-sergeant} to swap {inside-officer.him} off the dawn shift, voice rising.

care-swap-refused.1.2.line: {desk-sergeant} shrugs at {inside-officer} and leaves the roster alone.

care-swap-refused.1.3.line: {inside-officer} reads the roster on the screen, {inside-officer.his} name unchanged on the dawn shift.

care-arrest-at-the-pools.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} stands at the pools door in the early morning, a paper cup on the ledge.

care-arrest-at-the-pools.1.2.line: {boss-careless} takes the end stool at the tea counter, as on every other morning.

care-arrest-at-the-pools.1.3.line: {veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} step up to the stool and arrest {boss-careless}.

care-arrest-at-the-pools.1.5.line: {veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} lead {boss-careless} and {inside-officer} out through the lobby.

care-statement-and-closing.1.1.line: {boss-careless} sits at the interview table, hands flat on the tabletop.

care-statement-and-closing.1.2.line: {framed-officer} passes the paper notebook across the table to {veteran-officer}.

care-statement-and-closing.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} posts a notice to the station screens: "Case closed."

care-pool-cart-tea.1.1.line: {go-between-bartender} pours tea at the pool cart and serves {boss-careful} first.

care-pool-cart-tea.1.2.line: Patrons stack up in a line at the pool cart while {go-between-bartender} waits.

care-pool-cart-tea.1.3.line: {go-between-bartender} passes {boss-careful} a green token, a different color from the tea tokens.

care-pool-cart-tea.1.4.line: {go-between-bartender} leaves through the service door, right on the hour.

care-bump-at-the-lift.1.1.line: {go-between-bartender} and {go-between-courier} bump shoulders at the lift doors without a word.

care-bump-at-the-lift.1.3.line: {go-between-bartender} and {go-between-courier} step into two different lifts.

care-flat-on-the-third.1.1.line: {boss-careful} walks along the tenement corridor in the evening with a towel roll.

care-flat-on-the-third.1.3.line: The lamp in the window of flat 3B stays off after {boss-careful} goes in.

care-station-2-asks.1.1.line: {inside-officer-extra} sits a little apart from the others at the briefing.

care-station-2-asks.1.3.line: {desk-sergeant} points at the schedule on the wall.

care-station-2-asks.1.4.line: {inside-officer-extra} is the first one out of the briefing room.

care-late-to-the-handoff.1.1.line: Comm, one side, in the lift lobby: "I said ten. Ten, not eleven."

care-late-to-the-handoff.1.2.line: {family-caller-officer} leaves the lift lobby and is gone for ten minutes.

care-late-to-the-handoff.1.3.line: {family-caller-officer} comes back to the lift lobby carrying a takeaway bag.

care-late-to-the-handoff.1.4.line: {go-between-bartender} passes a token to {extra:stranger} at the lift doors.

care-late-to-the-handoff.1.5.line: {night-stakeout-officer} follows {go-between-bartender} at a distance toward the tenements.

care-flat-3b-opened.1.1.line: {night-stakeout-officer} waits at the end of the tenement corridor before dawn.

care-flat-3b-opened.1.2.line: {veteran-officer} and {rookie-officer} knock at flat 3B and wait.

care-flat-3b-opened.1.3.line: {rookie-officer} lifts a pile of towels off a chair inside flat 3B.

care-flat-3b-opened.1.4.line: Rolled inside the towels are credit slips with the tea counter stamp.

care-flat-3b-opened.1.5.line: {rookie-officer} seals the credit slips in an evidence bag.

care-arrest-in-the-corridor-closing.1.1.line: {veteran-officer} and {framed-officer} wait outside flat 3B in the early morning.

care-arrest-in-the-corridor-closing.1.2.line: {boss-careful} opens the door of flat 3B, and {veteran-officer} and {framed-officer} arrest {boss-careful.him}.

care-arrest-in-the-corridor-closing.1.5.line: {veteran-officer} and {night-stakeout-officer} lead all three out through the tenement lobby.

care-arrest-in-the-corridor-closing.2.1.line: {desk-sergeant} posts a notice to the station screens: "Case closed."
